keywords: Vitalik 提出用新形式的状态超扩容
LUCID 加密内存池 Hegotá 头号提案
ACDC #174 FOCIL 最可能成为共识层头号
EIP-7918 与 Fusaka 元 EIP 定稿
summary: VitalikButerin 发文提出通过创造新形式的状态实现状态超扩容。jflo 等人提出 Hegotá 头号候选 LUCID 加密内存池：FOCIL 无法保护易受 MEV 影响的交易，LUCID 补上这一点。ACDC #174 认为 FOCIL 最可能成为共识层头号提案，下次 ACDC 选定。nerolation 提交把 EIP-7976 calldata 下限提高到 64/64。

items.topic: 交易隐私：LUCID 加密内存池
items.title: Magicians：Hegotá 头号提案 LUCID 加密内存池
items.note: （jflo，作者 Anders Elowsson、Julian Ma、Justin Florentine）09:37：FOCIL 让包含者传播必须进入下一槽的交易列表以抗审查，但无法保护易被 MEV 提取的交易；配套的 ethresear.ch：LUCID，带分布式载荷传播的加密内存池 08:10。
items.title_en: Magicians: Hegotá headliner LUCID encrypted mempool
items.note_en: (jflo, authors Anders Elowsson, Julian Ma, Justin Florentine), 09:37: FOCIL lets includers propagate lists of transactions that must land next slot for censorship resistance, but cannot protect transactions open to MEV extraction; companion post ethresear.ch: LUCID, encrypted mempool with distributed payload propagation, 08:10.

items.title: EIP-7976：calldata 下限提高到 64/64
items.note: （nerolation）提交：每字节由 15/60 改为 64/64 gas，10 MiB 载荷所需 gas 从约 1.05 亿升至约 6.71 亿。
items.title_en: EIP-7976: increase the floor data cost to 64/64
items.note_en: (nerolation), submitted: from 15/60 to 64/64 gas per byte, raising a 10 MiB payload from about 105M to about 671M gas.

items.title: ACDC #174
items.note: 21:00，据 Ethereal news #10：Hegotá 共识层头号候选为 FOCIL（EIP-7805） 与 部分重建与 2D PeerDAS，FOCIL 获客户端团队强力支持，下次 ACDC 选定；EIP-8136 cell 级增量向后兼容，以功能开关启用，无需升级。
items.note_en: 21:00, per Ethereal news #10: Hegotá consensus headliner candidates are FOCIL (EIP-7805) and partial reconstruction and 2D PeerDAS, with strong client support for FOCIL and a pick at the next ACDC; EIP-8136 cell level deltas are backwards compatible and ship behind a feature flag without an upgrade.

keywords_en: Vitalik proposes hyper-scaling state through new forms of state
the LUCID encrypted mempool Hegotá headliner
ACDC #174 sees FOCIL as the likely consensus headliner
EIP-7976 raises the calldata floor to 64/64
EIP-7918 and the Fusaka meta EIP go Final
summary_en: VitalikButerin proposed hyper-scaling state by creating new forms of state. jflo and coauthors proposed the LUCID encrypted mempool as a Hegotá headliner: FOCIL cannot protect MEV exposed transactions, and LUCID fills that gap. ACDC #174 saw FOCIL as the likely consensus headliner, to be chosen at the next ACDC. nerolation submitted raising the EIP-7976 calldata floor to 64/64.
